items.summary: Idno versions up to and including 1.6.4 have a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in the /webmention/ endpoint. items.title: CVE-2026-135689: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') in…
items.summary: CVE-2026-135689 is a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Community Store for Concrete CMS versions before 2.8.0. It allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts via the order email field in the orders management page. When a store manager views an order containing a crafted email, the injected script executes in their session.

items.summary: CivetWeb versions up to 1.16, when built with HTTP/2 support enabled, contain a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the HTTP/2 header decoding function. This flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to send a specially crafted HEADERS frame over TLS to read one byte beyond the allocated heap buffer. (CVSS: 6.3)

items.summary: CleverReach® WP versions before 1.5.28 have a missing authorization vulnerability in the ArticleSearch controller. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to access non-public posts by enumerating post IDs. As a result, attackers can retrieve raw content of draft, pending, private, and password-protected posts and pages without authentication. (CVSS: 6.9)

items.summary: A medium severity vulnerability in Tanium Enforce Recovery Key Portal allows uncontrolled resource consumption. This issue was addressed in version 2.0.159. (CVSS: 5.3)
